RESULT

No pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants were identified in genes currently associated

This is a non-diagnostic result. It does not exclude a genetic cause.

Limitations: singleton exome sequencing without parental samples limits interpretation of
variants of uncertain significance. This assay does not detect repeat expansions,
methylation abnormalities, deep intronic variants, or copy number changes below the
resolution of the pipeline. Fragile X (FMR1) repeat testing was not performed as part of
this assay.

Reanalysis of the sequencing data may be requested through the referring clinician.
